headline: How to pay off multiple debts at once
lede: Keep the balance, rate and minimum payment for every debt in one place.

pin.title: How to Pay Off Multiple Debts at Once
pin.description: Picking snowball or avalanche is rarely the hard part. Keeping track is. List each debt's balance, interest rate and minimum payment in one place and watch the combined total drop month over month; that number is what keeps people going long after the new year.
